anomalies.observed: The anodes (pin 2 = "A") of the three Ethernet status LEDs D11, D12 and D36 are tied together on net /NET0037, which has no other nodes — no connection to +3V3, 3.3V_PI_OUT or any other supply rail. Their cathodes (pin 1 = "K") go through R70/R35/R57 to the CM4 open-drain pins Ethernet_nLED3 (Module2.15), PI_nLED_Activity (Module2.21) and Ethernet_nLED2 (Module2.17). By contrast every other discrete status LED on the board has its anode tied to a supply (e.g. D9.2 and D38.2 sit on +3V3 via R69/R60, D5.2 sits on +3V3 via R69).
anomalies.expected: The common-anode net for the Ethernet LEDs should be connected to a positive supply (e.g. +3V3, matching the other status LEDs), so that when the CM4 nLED pin sinks current the LED conducts. A common-anode node left floating cannot supply any current.
anomalies.impact: The three Ethernet link/activity LEDs can never illuminate because their common anode has no supply connection; the board loses its Ethernet status indication even though the CM4 drives the cathode side correctly.

anomalies.observed: R46's value field is "24k" (SPICE also models it as 24k), but its own description and MPN say 24 ohm: description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS" and MPN "FRC0805J240TSD" (240 = 24Ω). R46 sits across VOUTP/VOUTN, the Bob-Smith/common-mode termination nodes fed by the D27/D47 bridge rectifiers.
anomalies.expected: The value field and the ordering metadata (description/MPN) should describe the same resistance. In a 75Ω Bob-Smith termination network a 24Ω bleed would load the network heavily, so one of the two numbers is wrong.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R46") (value "24k") (footprint "Resistor_SMD:R_0805_2012Metric") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD") ... (field (name "Description") " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS"))

anomalies.impact: If the board is assembled from the BOM (24Ω) rather than the schematic value (24k), the VOUTP/VOUTN network is about 1000x lower in resistance than the schematic intends, loading the Ethernet common-mode termination and the Q4/R88/R101/D33/D34 sense network.

parsed.summary: The design files contain an apparent open connection: the anodes of the three Ethernet status LEDs (D11/D12/D36) are tied only to each other on net /NET0037 and to no supply rail, so those LEDs cannot light; a secondary inconsistency exists in R46 whose value (24k) disagrees with its description/MPN (24Ω).
